name: Ruputna
source: A very energetic girl from "Spirit World". Because Ruputna spent most of her life with Spirits, she is distrustful of other humans, and unfamiliar with ways of human world. Although Ruptuna is often short-tempered and act instinctively, she is very pure and innocent at heart.
